{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs/task-85a5e263.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill the hollow square with diagonal color pairs from its corner markers."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find the square outline (the 5-valued frame).
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    top = min(r for r, _ in frame)
    bottom = max(r for r, _ in frame)
    left = min(c for _, c in frame)
    right = max(c for _, c in frame)
    hmid, vmid = (top + bottom) // 2, (left + right) // 2

    # Each nonzero marker outside the frame identifies its corner color.
    markers = [(r, c, value) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row)
               if value != 0 and value != 5 and (r < top or r > bottom or c < left or c > right)]
    colors = {}
    for r, c, value in markers:
        vertical = 0 if r < hmid else 1
        horizontal = 0 if c < vmid else 1
        colors[(vertical, horizontal)] = value

    # Corner marker colors occupy their own quadrant and its diagonal opposite.
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            quadrant = (0 if r <= hmid else 1, 0 if c <= vmid else 1)
            out[r][c] = colors.get(quadrant, colors.get((1-quadrant[0], 1-quadrant[1]), 0))
    return out
"
}
